description: Environment-derived runtime settings: secrets, filesystem paths and HTTP client identity. Never contains any estimation constant -- those live only in EnrichmentParams / AnalysisParams / AcquisitionConfig, loaded separately from config/parameters.toml.
signature:
@dataclass(frozen=True)
class Settings:
    db_path: Path
    steam_web_api_key: str | None
    http_timeout_seconds: float
    user_agent: str
    parameters_path: Path
docstring:
Immutable, environment-derived settings for one process invocation.

Attributes:
    db_path: Absolute path to the SQLite database file (data/analyses.db by default). Resolved with pathlib so it is correct on both the Windows development machine and any Linux execution host.
    steam_web_api_key: Value of STEAM_WEB_API_KEY, or None if unset. Absence is not fatal at construction time -- it is validated lazily by acquisition.SteamStoreClient / SteamReviewsClient, the first callers that actually need it.
    http_timeout_seconds: Per-request timeout applied by acquisition.HttpClient.
    user_agent: Custom User-Agent string identifying this tool to Steam/SteamSpy, per ARCHITECTURE.md's terms-of-service-safety driver.
    parameters_path: Absolute path to config/parameters.toml, passed to load_parameters.
preconditions: db_path and parameters_path are constructed as pathlib.Path instances, never raw strings joined with os separators
postconditions: The instance is frozen (immutable) for the lifetime of the process
steam_web_api_key is either None or a non-empty string; an empty string in the environment is normalized to None by load_settings, never stored as ''

edge_cases.input: STEAM_WEB_API_KEY set to an empty string in the environment
http_timeout_seconds <= 0 supplied directly to the constructor (bypassing load_settings)
db_path given as a relative path
edge_cases.expected_behavior: accepted as-is by the dataclass; load_settings is responsible for resolving it to an absolute path before constructing Settings

unit_tests.name: test_settings_is_immutable
unit_tests.description: Attempting to assign to a field after construction raises FrozenInstanceError.

unit_tests.name: test_settings_rejects_non_positive_timeout
unit_tests.description: Constructing Settings with http_timeout_seconds=0 raises ValueError.
